Yes, we’re super excited to say we do ship internationally! For most countries, customs fees and import duties are the responsibility of the customer. Here’s a quick breakdown:

For the UK and most of Europe, import taxes and duties are included in the price, so there are no extra charges when your order arrives.
For the USA, from 16 May 2025, a 30% tariff will apply to your purchase due to new regulations. These charges go directly to the US government and are not covered by us.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges are set by your local authorities and will need to be paid by you.

If you want all the details, you can check out our full shipping policy here: Shipping Policy.
